page.layout: One page of text, one column, with the paradigm lines set in short centred or ragged-left groups. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre-right, page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: Quartum futurum tempus.
main_text.l: Εἴθε τυπτοίμι, utinam verberarem, τύπτοις, τυπτοῖ. [?]
τυπτοῖεν, τυπτοῖτε, τυπτοῖεν, à futuro secundo. [?]
main_text.head: Quintum futurum tempus.
main_text.l: Ἴσθι vel ἔστω, es, ἔστω, vel ἔστο, esto ille.
main_text.head: Sextum futurum tempus.
Septimum futurum tempus.
Octavum futurum tempus.

page.notes: The Greek is printed in a small italic face and is only partly legible on the scan. Words marked [?] are my best reading of the letters. The accents and the breathings in particular are uncertain, and the first two lines at the top are a fragment continued from the previous page. The bottom-right fragment "τύπτε," is the catchword. Show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.
